name: Berrys Creek
description: A tidal creek in East Rutherford that runs past highways and the large parking lots around the Meadowlands sports complex.

name: Mill Creek
description: A creek in Secaucus that borders the Mill Creek Marsh nature preserve, where herons often feed.

name: Overpeck Creek
description: A tidal creek through Overpeck County Park, where wetland restoration has been ongoing.
